screens.title: A sophisticated cartoon illustration of Tenali Raman, the wise Indian court jester. He is wearing a bright saffron dhoti, a purple shawl over his shoulders, and has a peacock feather tucked into his traditional hairstyle. He has a bald head with a small tuft of hair (shikha), a wise and mischievous smile, and a clean-shaven face. Standing next to him is a large, ornate golden oil lamp (diya) with a warm glowing flame. Style: Polished digital art with Mughal miniature painting influences, vibrant but refined colors, flat but textured shading. White background.
